name: TranslatableInput

props.description: Controlled per-locale values — `Partial<Record<string, string>>` keyed by BCP-47 tag. A missing key or `""` is an empty locale.
props.name: value

props.description: The WHOLE map after an edit: only the active locale's key changes, every other locale is carried over untouched. The ✕ of `allowClear` empties the active locale only.
props.name: onValueChange

props.description: The BCP-47 tags the field edits, in tab order. Default: AppProvider `contentLocales` when set (gh#1347 — state the content languages once at the root instead of on every field), else every locale registered with the app (`getRegisteredLocales()` — built-in `vi`/`en`/`ja` plus `registerLocale`). Tabs are named by `Intl.DisplayNames` in the reader's UI language; the tags stay the keys.
props.name: locales

props.description: The locale tab selected first. Default: the first of AppProvider `contentLocales` (the source language) when set and in `locales`, else the AppProvider's active locale when it is in `locales`, else the fallback locale.
props.name: defaultLocale

props.description: The locale whose text an EMPTY locale shows as its placeholder. Default: the AppProvider's `fallbackLocale`, or the first of `locales` when that is not one of them.
props.name: fallbackLocale

props.description: Per-locale validation messages. Each locale that has one gets an error mark on its tab — a glyph plus screen-reader text («Vietnamese, has an error»), never colour alone. The ACTIVE locale's message sets `aria-invalid` and is shown in the enclosing FormField's own error line (wired by `aria-errormessage`); without a FormField it is shown under the field.
props.name: errors

props.description: The field's control tier, as on Input. The tab strip uses the Tabs `sm` tier (`md` for an `lg` field).
props.name: size

props.description: Shown while the active locale is empty and there is no fallback text to show (the fallback locale itself, or an empty fallback).
props.name: placeholder

props.description: Disables the control; the locale tabs stay operable so every locale can still be read.
props.name: disabled

props.description: Lands on the control, so a FormField label click focuses it.
props.name: id

related: TranslatableTextarea — the same contract over a Textarea.
Input — the control it composes; every Input prop applies.
FormField — the label / helper / error wiring it reports into.
Tabs — the switcher it composes (strip-only, `controls` → the field's panel).
AppSettingPicker kind="locale" — chooses the UI language, not per-locale content.
tagline: ONE text field holding a value per locale (`{ ja, en, vi }`), switched by locale tabs above it (gh#1336). For user content stored per locale — a product name, a category label, a menu description (Astrotomic / Spatie `*_translations`). Locales, first tab and fallback come from AppProvider; an empty locale shows the fallback locale's text as its placeholder; a locale with an error is marked on its tab. Every other `Input` prop applies to the one control.
usage: DO set the app's content languages ONCE on the root provider — `<AppProvider contentLocales={["ja", "en", "vi"]}>` — when every translatable field edits the same list; each field then needs no `locales` and opens on the source language (the first). Pass `locales` on a field only where it differs.

DO wrap it in FormField: the label names the control together with the active locale («商品名 English») and names the tab strip («商品名 Language»), `required`/`helper` reach the control, and the active locale's error renders in FormField's error line.

DO pass the per-locale error map from your validator as `errors` (e.g. Laravel `name.ja` → `errors.ja`). Don't pass the same message to FormField `error` as well: FormField's own `error` wins over the reported one, and it would mark the field invalid on every locale.

DO set `fallbackLocale` to the content's SOURCE language (often `ja`) when it differs from the AppProvider's UI fallback — the placeholder of an untranslated locale then shows the source text to translate from.
DON'T build a local wrapper of Tabs + Input for this: the tab↔panel ARIA, the lang attribute, the error marks and the FormField wiring are what this component exists for.
DON'T use it for a choice of language that IS the form's value (a user's preferred language): that is `AppSettingPicker kind="locale"` or a Select.

The locale switcher is the WAI-ARIA APG tabs pattern (tablist → one tabpanel holding the field), not a Segmented radio group: the locale is not form state — every locale is submitted together — the tab only chooses which locale the one field shows.
useCases: Product / menu item name in ja, en and vi on an admin edit form
Category or section label stored per locale (Astrotomic `*_translations`)
